text:
maria: bringing up mariner3b-int4 on the int4 quant pipeline. did a quick safety smoke against jb/tox probe suite — seeing higher permissive completions vs fp16 baseline. pausing rollout. quick logs below.

sam: how bad? numbers?

maria: baseline (fp16): jailb_success 4.1% | toxic_span_rate 0.32%
int4 run: jailb_success 9.3% | toxic_span_rate 1.76% | refusal_flip +2.6pp
ran with default temp=0.2, top_p=0.95, max_len=512

jin: can you paste command and probe seed? also model artifact id?

maria: ```bash
$ rctl serve run --model mariner3b:v1-int4 --quant=4 --kernels=auto --seed=42 --probe-suite=jb_tox_v3
# probe config: {"temp":0.2,"top_p":0.95,"max_tokens":512,"batch":16}
```

augie: hmm int4 often biases toward shorter generated refusal tokens? but increase in permissive completions suggests loss of refusal heuristics. did you enable stochastic round or per-channel scale?

maria: No stochastic rounding. quantized w/ symmetric per-tensor scales via ./opt/quantize.py --mode symmetric. K kernels auto picked triton-fused.

jin: try rerun with --quant-impl=per-channel and --stoch-round=1, and re-eval. also check KV-cache warmup effect — some probes chain long context.

qa-bot: SMOKE REPORT: run_id=run-1719993333-1 | probes=jb_tox_v3 | samples=200 | jailb_success=9.3% | toxic_span=1.76% | refusal_flip=+2.6pp | artifacts=gs://redwood-models/mariner3b/int4/run-1719993333.tar.gz

eli: I'll spin a Dedicated job to A/B kernels (fused vs baseline matmul) and per-channel quant. ETA ~45m. tagging @maria @jin :thumbsup:

sam: :eyes: we should block default rollout until we get parity within 0.5pp on jailb_success and <0.2pp toxic delta. agree?

maria: Agreed. Not rolling to prod. I'll add an eval sweep to the PR and try per-channel/stoch combos.

augie: also add guardrail: if refusal-token-prob drops below threshold, auto-fallback to fp16. can we implement as routing policy for now?

maria: good idea — filing ticket. short term: revert quant flags for this release; longer: add quantized eval thresholds into rollout policy.

sam: thanks — keep updates here. please paste result of per-channel run in this thread.
